title: First Halting Time
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed Boolean input, and let $t$ be a natural number. If $c$ is not halted but the run from $c$ is halted at time $t$, then there is a time $u$ with $0<u\le t$ such that the run is not halted at every earlier time, is halted at time $u$, and has the same configuration at time $u$ as at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A multi-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols
A configuration $c$ on a fixed Boolean input
The starting configuration is not halted
The run is halted at time $t
